DECODE_GRAD = false → zdec = z.detach() , the decoder still trains, the encoder never sees it
the same boolean, the two representations – the comparison INVERTS
same head, same λ, same seeds, same eval instrument on both sides – only the feature and the boolean differ

closing the switch moves the mean DOWN
the SAME boolean, opposite signs: +0.140 on a 98 304-dim latent, −0.060 on a 384-dim one
no mechanism is claimed: the four means and the sign flip are the whole statement, and neither contrast excludes zero
